metadata-boundary.operation: reassess typed native metadata and serialization observation boundary
metadata-boundary.prerequisite: These are MUST clauses, not permissions. Generic scope treats the JSON exchange guarantees as construction-only; current nativeResult also marshals typed native values. Reassess attributable shape/serialization evidence before a new case; JSON parsing alone cannot prove the subject serializer.

native-result.operation: resolve or dereference; inspect original metadata, accessor snapshot and representation bytes
native-result.prerequisite: Add independent assertions and applicable positive/negative cases against actual native outputs. Evaluate each condition; do not assume PASS.

dereference-input.operation: actual subject dereference string-entry or attributed parsing observer
dereference-input.prerequisite: The current native adapter parses q.Input with did.ParseURL before invoking DereferenceWithCode. Adapter parsing failures and handler-only errors cannot prove the dereferencing algorithm invalid-input branch.

native-errors.operation: resolve/dereference with valid fixture record and independent request or source-failure option
native-errors.prerequisite: Preserve exact actual error, null content and metadata; distinguish resolver execution from adapter input rejection or pre-handler parsing.

native-key-document.operation: resolve(application/did); inspect actual selected JsonWebKey definitions
native-key-document.prerequisite: Scope to actual produced methods; distinguish class definitions, optional values and recommendations. Any alg verdict must be fresh and may FAIL.

server-wire.operation: http/http-comparison via owned loopback TLS SAGE handler
server-wire.prerequisite: Compare actual response headers/body to a separate actual native call. These observations do not test a client request builder.

client-binding.operation: actual subject HTTP client request-construction and response-consumption observer
client-binding.prerequisite: The current requests are constructed by inspector checks.BindingRequest and sent to a subject handler. Add an actual client actor; never assign inspector-built request behavior to the server.

parser-reference.operation: direct subject DID/DID URL parsing and RFC3986 reference resolution
parser-reference.prerequisite: Expose these actual operations with independently derived syntax/reference controls; current SAGE Subject.Supports returns false for generic capability interfaces.

representation-consumer.operation: direct subject producer/consumer with arbitrary document and representation entries
representation-consumer.prerequisite: Add an explicit adapter operation and preserve original input/output; fixed record projection alone cannot prove general consumption or extension preservation.

method-retrieval.operation: actual CID retrieval/fragment algorithm and dedicated error interface
method-retrieval.prerequisite: DID key dereferencing is not proof of the complete CID retrieval algorithm or security vocabulary. Preserve actor, algorithm and actual error namespace.

conditional-fields.operation: native/document observation with additional applicable field or representation inputs
conditional-fields.prerequisite: Current fixed records omit these fields or forms. Add applicable public inputs and verify actual subject support; absent fields never become evidence for a conditional MUST.

multikey-material.operation: actual Multikey/multibase/multihash producer, consumer or codec
multikey-material.prerequisite: Selected SAGE projection emits JsonWebKey, not Multikey. Expose actual support and independent public vectors; do not repair the type or fabricate subject output.

codec-internals.operation: codec trace/equivalence observer or independently testable codec interface
codec-internals.prerequisite: A document byte match does not demonstrate every internal arithmetic step. Existing generic scope has no codec capability; alternative algorithms may be permitted.

jsonld-processing.operation: actual JSON-LD/RDF processing and network/context-resolution instrumentation
jsonld-processing.prerequisite: A returned @context is syntax evidence only. No current operation observes processing, injection, remote retrieval or offline context trust.

history-proof-service.operation: conditional resolution/dereferencing with history, proof, relative expansion, service selection or proxy data
history-proof-service.prerequisite: The fixed current-record Source and restricted did:sage input cannot exercise every branch. First expose applicable inputs and actual feature support; generic fixtures are not this subject evidence.

authority.operation: authoritative document/source/controller and update authorization evidence
authority.prerequisite: Fixture Source, URL equality and controller strings do not establish authoritative storage or update capability. Operational registry/contract integration remains separately deferred.

deployment.operation: trusted remote resolver/source, forks or deployment assurance
deployment.prerequisite: Owned loopback TLS does not establish production trust, mutual authentication, upstream proof provenance or deployed chain behavior. Require approved operational choices.

specification.operation: method/representation/extension specification and privacy/security consideration review
specification.prerequisite: Review the addressed specification or registrant, not a resolver output. Registration recommendations remain deferred; this audit submits nothing.

permission-definition.prerequisite: A MAY, OPTIONAL, definition or construction-only invariant is not a runtime PASS obligation. Keep baseline NOT_RUN and record applicable evidence before a later decision.

normative-conflict.prerequisite: Preserve both sides of the conflict and their ids; do not invent a failing optionality rule or silently change the pinned standard.
